hack.root_cause: Flash loan + Curve Y-pool spot price manipulation → inflated fToken share valuation → vault drain
hack.description: An attacker flash-loaned $50M and cycled a Curve pool stablecoin imbalance 32 times over 7 minutes, exploiting Harvest Finance's spot-price oracle to drain $33.8M — while leaving $400M more vulnerable but untouched.
